events.name: New York Rangers at Chicago Blackhawks

headlines.description: — Connor Bedard scored his 19th goal, Spencer Knight made 21 saves for his second shutout this season, and the Chicago Blackhawks beat the New York Rangers 3-0 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Connor Bedard scores 19th goal as Blackhawks blank Rangers 3-0

events.name: Detroit Red Wings at Calgary Flames

headlines.description: — Alex DeBrincat extended his points streak to five games with two goals and an assist, and the Detroit Red Wings held off the Calgary Flames 4-3 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Alex DeBrincat has 2 goals and an assist as Red Wings hold off Flames 4-3

headlines.description: — Anton Lundell scored with 50.8 seconds left, batting a loose puck in front of the net home to lift the Florida Panthers to a 4-3 win over the Utah Mammoth on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lundell scores late, Panthers top Mammoth 4-3 for third consecutive win

events.name: Los Angeles Kings at Seattle Kraken

headlines.description: — Vince Dunn scored on the power play 1:21 into overtime and the Seattle Kraken snapped a five-game losing streak on Wednesday night by beating the Los Angeles Kings, 3-2.
headlines.shortLinkText: Vince Dunn scores in OT as Kraken beat Kings, end five-game skid
